response.title: which power station can run a well pump the most times before it is empty
response.answer:
For running a well pump the most times on a single charge, the best power station is generally the one with the largest usable battery capacity (Wh or kWh) that can also handle the pump's startup surge.

However, well pumps are challenging because they often require 3–5 times their normal running power to start.

There are three important specifications:

Battery capacity (kWh): Determines how many pumping cycles you can get.

Surge output (W): Determines whether the pump can start.

Continuous output (W): Determines whether the pump can keep running.

For a typical 240V residential well pump, you'll also need a power station that supports 240V output, not just standard 120V outlets.

Best power stations for a well pump

Here are three strong options, comparing a single base unit without expansion batteries.

Assume your well pump uses 1,500W while running, runs for 5 minutes each cycle, and the power station delivers 85% of its rated battery energy through AC.
